summary.name: Photocopy Art / Zine Design. Supplemental design reference in the Printmaking and Craft Materials category. The source does not name it as a directly named style.
summary.visualIdentity: Explicit cues: high-contrast photographs, photocopy grain, cutout headlines, tape or staples, and irregular page layouts. Keep one information center, use monochrome with an optional accent, and keep grain and torn edges fixed.
summary.suitableUses: Explicit best-fit uses: activist explainers, DIY guides, community announcements, band promos, lyric zines, and music event recaps. Inferred suitability: raw page collages and zine-style explainers with one focal point. Supporting styles are optional.
summary.limitations: The renderer stack is empty, so assets must be preprocessed, for example with Pillow, and composited in the chosen framework. Two-color contrast checks do not verify text over grain, textures, or video. Grain must not be reseeded. Unspecified: fonts, page sizes, and aspect ratios.
summary.palette: Background policy is scene_dependent, and the palette is a style-compatible suggestion rather than approved exact colors. Suggested tokens: background #FFFFFF, foreground #000000, and optional accent_1 #BF3232; omit the accent for fully monochrome. Black on white is 21:1 and accent on white is 5.649:1. Gradients are disabled. Task or approved colors override these tokens.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Explicit cues: animate page changes, pasting, and recomposition while keeping lettering readable. Optional motion references are motion-007, 008, 012, and 015 for layout or narrative, plus motion-037, 038, and 040 for headline dispersal, punctuation crops, and designed cuts. Choose none when a reference does not fit the scene. Web delivery may use scroll; video uses composition time.
summary.audio: No audio is specified for this style, and audio is optional. Suggested only: a beat-locked paste rhythm from a verified beat table, or restrained ambience or silence. Voiceover and sung vocals are unspecified. Do not infer beats without audio analysis, and do not trigger sound for every paste.
summary.assetRequirements: Assets must be supplied or created: high-contrast photographs or imagery, cut headline lettering, torn-edge and grain textures, and tape or staple elements. Preprocessing is required, with Pillow in Python or Sharp in Node.js. Source assets and exact copy are unspecified in the input.
summary.combinations: Photocopy/Zine alone suits raw collages. Style-024 may add black or optional red marker arrows and circles at one focal point, with readable body text. Style-105 may add beat-locked paste and page-turn timing with fixed grain and reading holds. Avoid a third ink color, full-frame flashing, and pasting everything at once.
summary.productionApproach: Use HyperFrames as the primary render pipeline with data-composition-id, class="clip" timing, and one paused GSAP timeline registered in window.__timelines. Validate and export with its check, snapshot, and render commands. Use Remotion only under the documented fallback condition. The style renderer is not fixed: Canvas 2D, DOM, or SVG are options, with Pillow preprocessing and GSAP as the single motion owner.
